Package org.apache.hadoop.io.wrappedio

@Public @Evolving package org.apache.hadoop.io.wrappedio
Support for dynamic access to filesystem operations which are not available in older hadoop releases.

Classes in this package tagged as @InterfaceAudience#Public export methods to be loaded by reflection by other applications/libraries. Tests against these SHOULD use reflection themselves so as to guarantee stability of reflection-based access.

Classes tagged as private/limited private are for support and testing.
